type: Minimalist Swiss typographic large text poster.
goal: Generate a minimalist poster in 2:3 or 1:1 format, with grid and font size hierarchy as the only interest, without illustrations, photos, or gradients.

headline.size: Occupies 40% height and 70% width of the frame
headline.alignment: Align to the left in a 12-column grid, with the left edge 1/12 away from the empty column.
headline.treatment: No uniform sans-serif weight 700, letter spacing -2%, no outlines, no noise, no halftone

subheadline.size: The font height of the main label is 0.2.
subheadline.position: 12mm (scaled accordingly) beneath the main label is left-aligned, with all uppercase and numbers mixed, with a 1pt fine line between English words.

items: Dialogue: Jensen Huang video speech · Offline guests include two local planning scholars (here for typesetting illustration, not listing real names)
small_text.position: In the lower right and lower left of the image: lower left for hosting, lower right for dialogue, both at 8pt equivalent English thin body height.

design.decoration: A 0.5pt horizontal line at 18% from the bottom edge, extending from left 1/3 to right 2/3, must not touch other text.
design.typography_family: Chinese: New grotesk sans-serif; English: same family Latin part; prohibit calligraphic type

aspect_ratio: 1:1 scalable to 2:3, adding only top and bottom white space without pulling text

must_keep: Text still occupies the absolute main body but restrained whitespace has breathing, unlike Word centered large text
The entire image is only in black and white, with no large areas of grayscale (screen grayscale allowed for text anti-aliasing)
decoration has only one line + small text, no logo color blocks added
avoid: Add geometric noise to fill in the blanks
The title exceeds seven characters; this example has used four characters and should not exceed eight characters if revised.
